## Install

### Windows

Download `AutoSwitchKVM.App-win-Setup.exe` (x64) or `AutoSwitchKVM.App-win-arm64-Setup.exe`
(ARM64) and run it. The installer isn't signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first
run: choose **More info ▸ Run anyway**. Later updates install from inside the app.

### macOS

Download `AutoSwitchKVM-{VERSION}-macos.dmg` and drag AutoSwitch KVM into Applications.

The app isn't notarized by Apple yet, so macOS blocks the first open. Open it once, then
go to System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security and click **Open Anyway** (or run
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/AutoSwitchKVM.app`). Later updates
install from inside the app.
